source_doc: UK House of Commons, Written Answers, 28 March 1963 (Mr Corfield to Mr P. Noel-Baker), Civil Defence (Evacuation), HC Deb vol 674 cc179-80W
quote: I am also sending him a list of the 19 areas from which dispersal would take place if the scheme were put into effect. Dispersal Areas (Named mostly after the main Town or City they contain)
notes: Area from which the priority classes (about 9.5 million people; HC Deb 2 May 1963 cc1299-300) would be dispersed under MHLG Circular of 16 Oct 1962. England and Wales only; Scotland planned separately (Scottish list not obtained). A dispersal area is the government's expectation of danger, not an explicit target designation; the area boundaries are not given in the answer. Selection criterion not stated.
